import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
p="data/crashes.parquet"
out=Path("out")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
con=duckdb.connect()
period="crash_date >= DATE '"'"'2013-01-01'"'"' AND crash_date < DATE '"'"'2026-01-01'"'"'"
weekday_case="CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM crash_date) WHEN 1 THEN '"'"'Monday'"'"' WHEN 2 THEN '"'"'Tuesday'"'"' WHEN 3 THEN '"'"'Wednesday'"'"' WHEN 4 THEN '"'"'Thursday'"'"' WHEN 5 THEN '"'"'Friday'"'"' WHEN 6 THEN '"'"'Saturday'"'"' WHEN 7 THEN '"'"'Sunday'"'"' END"
order_case="CASE weekday WHEN '"'"'Monday'"'"' THEN 1 WHEN '"'"'Tuesday'"'"' THEN 2 WHEN '"'"'Wednesday'"'"' THEN 3 WHEN '"'"'Thursday'"'"' THEN 4 WHEN '"'"''Friday'"'"' THEN 5 WHEN '"'"'Saturday'"'"' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END"
q=f"SELECT {weekday_case} weekday, COUNT(*) crashes FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE {period} GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY {order_case}"
df=con.execute(q,[p]).fetchdf()
df["share_percent"]=df.crashes/df.crashes.sum()*100
df.to_csv(out/"values_1.csv",index=False,float_format="%.6f")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.5))
bars=ax.bar(df.weekday,df.crashes/1000,color="#3b82b4")
ax.set_title("NYC police-reported crashes by weekday, 2013–2025")
ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
ax.set_ylabel("Crashes (thousands)")
ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25)
ax.bar_label(bars,labels=[f"{v/1000:.1f}k" for v in df.crashes],padding=3,fontsize=9)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_1.png",dpi=180); plt.close(fig)
q=f"SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INTEGER year, {weekday_case} weekday, COUNT(*) crashes FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE {period} GROUP BY year, weekday ORDER BY year, {order_case}"
ydf=con.execute(q,[p]).fetchdf()
allyears=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([range(2013,2026),df.weekday],names=["year","weekday"])
ydf=ydf.set_index(["year","weekday"]).reindex(allyears,fill_value=0).reset_index()
ydf["year_total"]=ydf.groupby("year").crashes.transform("sum")
ydf["share_percent"]=ydf.crashes/ydf.year_total*100
ydf.to_csv(out/"values_2.csv",index=False,float_format="%.6f")
piv=ydf.pivot(index="year",columns="weekday",values="share_percent").reindex(columns=df.weekday)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,7))
im=ax.imshow(piv.values,aspect="auto",cmap="YlGnBu")
ax.set_xticks(range(7),df.weekday,rotation=30,ha="right")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(piv.index)),piv.index)
ax.set_title("Weekday share of annual NYC crash totals, 2013–2025")
ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
ax.set_ylabel("Year")
for r in range(piv.shape[0]):
 for c in range(piv.shape[1]): ax.text(c,r,f"{piv.iloc[r,c]:.1f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,color="black")
cbar=fig.colorbar(im,ax=ax); cbar.set_label("Share of that year’s crashes (%)")
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_2.png",dpi=180); plt.close(fig)
print("OPTION 1\n",df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nOPTION 2 ANNUAL MAX/MIN WEEKDAY SHARE\n",ydf.loc[ydf.groupby("year").share_percent.idxmax(),["year","weekday","crashes","year_total","share_percent"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nRANGE AUDIT\n",con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date < DATE '"'"'2013-01-01'"'"' OR crash_date >= DATE '"'"'2026-01-01'"'"') out_of_range FROM read_parquet(?)",[p]).fetchdf().to_string(index=False))
'

+weekday_order = "CASE weekday WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END"
+
+overall_query = f"""
+    SELECT {weekday} AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS crashes
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE {period}
+    GROUP BY weekday
+    ORDER BY {weekday_order}
+"""
+overall = connection.execute(overall_query, [source]).fetchdf()
+overall["share_percent"] = overall.crashes / overall.crashes.sum() * 100
+overall.to_csv(output / "values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
+bars = ax.bar(overall.weekday, overall.crashes / 1000, color="#3b82b4")
+ax.set_title("NYC police-reported crashes by weekday, 2013–2025")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes (thousands)")
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value / 1000:.1f}k" for value in overall.crashes], padding=3, fontsize=9)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(output / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+annual_query = f"""
+    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
+           {weekday} AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS crashes
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE {period}
+    GROUP BY year, weekday
+    ORDER BY year, {weekday_order}
+"""
+annual = connection.execute(annual_query, [source]).fetchdf()
+weekdays = overall.weekday.tolist()
+full_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
+    [range(2013, 2026), weekdays], names=["year", "weekday"]
+)
+annual = annual.set_index(["year", "weekday"]).reindex(full_index, fill_value=0).reset_index()
+annual["year_total"] = annual.groupby("year").crashes.transform("sum")
+annual["share_percent"] = annual.crashes / annual.year_total * 100
+annual.to_csv(output / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+
+matrix = annual.pivot(index="year", columns="weekday", values="share_percent").reindex(columns=weekdays)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))
+image = ax.imshow(matrix.values, aspect="auto", cmap="YlGnBu")
+ax.set_xticks(range(7), weekdays, rotation=30, ha="right")
+ax.set_yticks(range(len(matrix.index)), matrix.index)
+ax.set_title("Weekday share of annual NYC crash totals, 2013–2025")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
+ax.set_ylabel("Year")
+for row in range(matrix.shape[0]):
+    for column in range(matrix.shape[1]):
+        ax.text(column, row, f"{matrix.iloc[row, column]:.1f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7, color="black")
+colorbar = fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax)
+colorbar.set_label("Share of that year’s crashes (%)")
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(output / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print("OPTION 1: OVERALL COUNTS AND SHARES")
+print(overall.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nOPTION 2: YEARLY HIGHEST-SHARE WEEKDAY")
+highest = annual.loc[annual.groupby("year").share_percent.idxmax(), ["year", "weekday", "crashes", "year_total", "share_percent"]]
+print(highest.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nRANGE AUDIT")
+audit = connection.execute("""
+    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
+           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date < DATE '2013-01-01' OR crash_date >= DATE '2026-01-01') AS out_of_range
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+""", [source]).fetchdf()
+print(audit.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch

+weekday_order = "CASE weekday WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END"
+
+overall_query = f"""
+    SELECT {weekday} AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS crashes
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE {period}
+    GROUP BY weekday
+    ORDER BY {weekday_order}
+"""
+overall = connection.execute(overall_query, [source]).fetchdf()
+overall["share_percent"] = overall.crashes / overall.crashes.sum() * 100
+overall.to_csv(output / "values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
+bars = ax.bar(overall.weekday, overall.crashes / 1000, color="#3b82b4")
+ax.set_title("NYC police-reported crashes by weekday, 2013–2025")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes (thousands)")
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{value / 1000:.1f}k" for value in overall.crashes], padding=3, fontsize=9)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(output / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+annual_query = f"""
+    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
+           {weekday} AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS crashes
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE {period}
+    GROUP BY year, weekday
+    ORDER BY year, {weekday_order}
+"""
+annual = connection.execute(annual_query, [source]).fetchdf()
+weekdays = overall.weekday.tolist()
+full_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
+    [range(2013, 2026), weekdays], names=["year", "weekday"]
+)
+annual = annual.set_index(["year", "weekday"]).reindex(full_index, fill_value=0).reset_index()
+annual["year_total"] = annual.groupby("year").crashes.transform("sum")
+annual["share_percent"] = annual.crashes / annual.year_total * 100
+annual.to_csv(output / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f")
+
+matrix = annual.pivot(index="year", columns="weekday", values="share_percent").reindex(columns=weekdays)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))
+image = ax.imshow(matrix.values, aspect="auto", cmap="YlGnBu")
+ax.set_xticks(range(7), weekdays, rotation=30, ha="right")
+ax.set_yticks(range(len(matrix.index)), matrix.index)
+ax.set_title("Weekday share of annual NYC crash totals, 2013–2025")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
+ax.set_ylabel("Year")
+for row in range(matrix.shape[0]):
+    for column in range(matrix.shape[1]):
+        ax.text(column, row, f"{matrix.iloc[row, column]:.1f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7, color="black")
+colorbar = fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax)
+colorbar.set_label("Share of that year’s crashes (%)")
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(output / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print("OPTION 1: OVERALL COUNTS AND SHARES")
+print(overall.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nOPTION 2: YEARLY HIGHEST-SHARE WEEKDAY")
+highest = annual.loc[annual.groupby("year").share_percent.idxmax(), ["year", "weekday", "crashes", "year_total", "share_percent"]]
+print(highest.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nRANGE AUDIT")
+audit = connection.execute("""
+    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
+           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date < DATE '2013-01-01' OR crash_date >= DATE '2026-01-01') AS out_of_range
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+""", [source]).fetchdf()
+print(audit.to_string(index=False))
